permissions.purpose: Match your Stripe customers to their signup so revenue can be attributed to the marketing channel that produced them.
Read the attribution metadata your checkout attaches, which is how a payment is tied back to a first visit.
Follow subscription starts, changes and cancellations to compute MRR per acquisition channel.
Read the recurring price on a subscription's items, which is what an MRR figure is computed from.
Record paid and failed invoices as the revenue behind each channel.
Record refunds so attributed revenue goes down when money is returned.
Record chargebacks so attributed revenue reflects disputed payments.
Receive webhook events for the objects above as they change, instead of polling your account.
